notes: C4 is marked 'partly' because P9 critiques relying on a single wavenumber at 10 cm-1 near the Rayleigh leak and recommends integrating over an 8-20 cm-1 window (and P6 critiques the arbitrary 15% threshold on that curve), rather than explicitly asking for a wavenumber-sensitivity plot of Tc. C9 is marked 'partly' because P12 proposes forward-modelling the layer-weighted Raman response with a Tc(z) profile rather than subtracting bulk layers to isolate the raw interface spectrum. C11 is marked 'partly' because P16 questions the 'absence of any notable interface effect' on ALD Al2O3 given its 15% Tc drop, without specifically invoking defect-mediated charge transfer in Al2O3.
